responsibility: This file implements GCC’s deterministic replacement for qsort and qsort_r, together with stable variants. It uses fixed comparator networks for very small partitions and a branch-light merge sort above that, trading some extra copying for reproducible ordering and better performance on typical GCC element sizes. The routines accept GCC’s relaxed comparator contract, allocate temporary buffers when needed, optionally force stability through a size encoding convention, and provide the gcc_qsort/gcc_sort_r/gcc_stablesort entry points that system.h redirects callers toward.
